text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before Admire Vega, who had become an 
empty shell after losing her sister, 
appeared T.M. Opera O, her booming 
laughter echoing through the air.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With no room left for argument, the 
Trainer, dragged along as their guardian, 
was taken to—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The midnight sea. Sharply rebuking a 
bewildered Admire Vega who was trying to 
walk away, T.M. Opera O tells her to wait 
for dawn.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, at the break of dawn, just as the 
morning star faded, Narita Top Road 
invited Admire Vega out for a run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running together, pouring out 
everything... Even after their bodies were 
completely drained, what drove them 
forward was the desire to run—the sheer 
joy of running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"That's why—from now on, it wouldn't be 
for atonement; she wanted to run to be an 
older sister her little sister could be 
proud of. She renewed her vow once more."
